payload.core_mechanism_summary: Dynamic programming from end to start, using 2D state (position, last suffix length) to determine possible suffixes of length 2 or 3, with constraint against immediate repetition.
payload.rationale: The solution employs a DP table a[i][0/1] representing whether a suffix of length 2 (0) or 3 (1) can start at i, updating based on future states and non-repetition rule. This is a classic 2D DP state.
